summary: Boundary County, ID ground cabin on Hunt Peak in the Kaniksu National Forest; camp 1927, L-4 cab 1931, abandoned 1935. No source describes the site today.

notes_for_editor: Camp, cab and abandonment dates agree across three sites. No source says when the cabin came down or what is on the summit now. A YouTube video (watch?v=Hhv1I5VFG0o) turned up in search with a description claiming remains (melted glass, nails, concrete supports) and a later forest-fire burn. The page could not be read here, so that claim is not used. Worth checking against a site report or Kaniksu National Forest records. The CCC photo is marked 'In Copyright - Educational Use Permitted', so it is cited but not added to photos.
